findings.title: Fire-and-forget telemetry promise has no rejection handler and runs on every request.
findings.body:
`void server.services.telemetry.identifyIdentity(...)` discards the promise without a `.catch`. Unless `identifyIdentity` catches every error internally, a PostHog failure (network error, timeout, bad config) becomes an unhandled rejection. On Node ≥15 that terminates the process by default, so an outage of an external analytics service could take down the API.

This also runs on every machine-identity request, not once per identity, which adds an outbound telemetry call to the auth hot path.

Fix: attach a `.catch(() => {})` (or log at debug level) here. Also dedupe or throttle per `identityId`, for example with a short-lived cache, so the identify call is not repeated for every API request.
